title: QA machine baselines
summary: Cursor baseline requests cap the first attempt at 50 seconds and retry once after a timeout or a tool-only rejection within the unchanged 110-second budget. Every harness's timed-out request (Claude, Codex and Cursor) records complete stream-event count and last type without content on the receipt; two Cursor timeouts retain probe_request_timed_out. Claude and Codex keep their single full-budget attempt. Codex can pass after stream error events when a later turn.completed confirms the exact OK reply and no turn.failed occurred. The receipt keeps the error-event count without message text. Interactive golden capture retains only after local verification and before submit releases its host lease. Begin names all registered goldens for the shared host/user plus the new destination; unknown registrations or another leased home refuse deletion.
